notes: family: abstract-objective. Azul: Master Chocolatier (limited edition), same end-game bonuses as base Azul. In-play scoring: each tile moved to the box scores 1, or the horizontally linked run plus the vertically linked run (newly placed tile included in each); foundry line penalties are applied at end of Box confection. Game ends right after the Box confection phase in which a player completes a horizontal line of 5. Brown-side variant and Special Factories not modelled (they do not change final scoring).
